message.content: The Battle of Waterloo, fought on June 18, 1815, resulted in roughly **25,000 casualties** in total—about 12,000–13,000 killed or mortally wounded, 10,000–11,000 wounded, and a few thousand missing or captured. These figures combine losses from both the Allied forces (British, Dutch, Belgian, Prussian) and the French army.
